displayName: PK Spot Functions: sustained service outage

conditions.displayName: At least 80% server failures with 10 requests in 10 minutes, sustained for 5 minutes
conditions.name: projects/parkour-base-project/alertPolicies/1585310550030443193/conditions/12544446071309426172

documentation.content: Email only for sustained near-total service failure: at least 80% HTTP 5xx among non-4xx/non-204 requests, with at least 10 such requests in the rolling 10-minute window, sustained for 5 minutes. Grouped by service and region. Isolated errors and 401/403/404 responses stay in logs. Overpass amenity service is excluded from this outage policy. Low-traffic, no-traffic and isolated scheduled-job failures may not trigger; use the external backend canary and log review for those cases.
